$comment: Library id -> {other-language name: why} for wger translations that are wrong or too generic for that exercise. These names would otherwise resolve imported workouts automatically (ImportPlan). Review: docs/import/wger-review.md. Re-run node scripts/map-wger.mjs after editing.

0027.Rematore presa neutra con bilanciere: Italian for a neutral-grip barbell row; this row uses an overhand grip.

0028.Cargada y envión: Spanish for clean and jerk, not clean and press.
0028.Umsetzen und Stoßen: German for clean and jerk, not clean and press.

0082.Langhantel-Handgelenkcurl mit Untergriff: German for the underhand (regular) wrist curl, not the reverse one.

0091.Military Press LH: Military press is usually standing; this exercise is the seated press.

0126.Handgelenkstreckung: German for wrist extension (the reverse movement).
0126.Kurzhantel-Unterarmcurl: German for the dumbbell wrist curl; this is the barbell one.

0165.Biceps concentrado martillo con cable: Spanish for a concentration hammer curl, a different variant.

0171.Cruce de Poleas para Pecho: Spanish for the standing cable crossover, not the incline cable fly.

0201.Extensión de tríceps en polea con cuerda: Rope pushdown; this exercise uses a bar (the rope version is 0200).

0251.Fundos Para Tríceps: Portuguese for triceps dips; this is the chest dip.

0274.仰卧起坐: Chinese for the sit-up, not the crunch.

0297.Curl biceps avec haltère: French for any dumbbell biceps curl, too generic for the concentration curl.

0319.Distensione Panca Inclinata Bilanciere: Italian for the incline barbell bench press, not the dumbbell fly.

0326.Aperturas Inversas: Spanish for any reverse fly, too generic.
0326.Alzate posteriori: Italian for any rear raise, too generic.

0405.Military Press KH: Military press is usually standing; this exercise is the seated press.
0405.Press Militar mancuerna: Military press is usually standing; this exercise is the seated press.

0472.Addominali alla sbarra: Italian for 'abs on the bar' in general, too generic.

0493.Distensione Panca Inclinata Bilanciere: Italian for the incline barbell bench press, not the incline push-up.

0575.Curl de bíceps sentado: Spanish for any seated biceps curl, too generic for the machine curl.

0757.Distensione su Panca Piana Imp Stretta: Italian for the flat close-grip bench press, not the Smith incline press.

0861.Remo gironda agarre cerrado: Spanish for the close-grip Gironda row, a specific variant.

1326.Trazioni alla sbarra: Italian for pull-ups on the bar in general, not specifically the underhand chin-up.

1631.Biceps concentrado: Spanish for any concentration curl, too generic for the cable version.

1760.Sentadilla con disco: Spanish for a squat holding a plate, not the dumbbell goblet squat.
